tools.name: find_store
tools.description: Find a retailer in Pricemend's coverage from a name a person used, such as 'old navy' or 'btech'. Returns store ids to pass to the other tools. Start here when you have a shop's name but not its id.

tools.name: store_policy
tools.description: A retailer's return and price-adjustment rules: how many days, whether it refunds a price drop or only takes returns, what's excluded, and whether Pricemend can read its live prices. Use find_store first if you only have a name.

tools.name: return_deadline
tools.description: The last day a shopper can act on something they bought, and what to do when they get there. This is the main tool: give it the store and the purchase date and it returns the deadline, the days left, and whether the shop refunds the difference or the shopper should return and rebuy. channel is 'onli

tools.name: statutory_rights
tools.description: What the law in a country gives a shopper on top of whatever the retailer offers, with the legislation cited. Covers US, CA, GB, ES, AE, SA, EG and IN. Worth checking outside the US, where the statutory right is often stronger than the shop's own policy.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: What a product costs on a retailer's site right now. Takes a product link, or a model or article number for the stores that have one indexed. Only works for stores whose policy record says price_checkable is true; the rest block automated requests and will return an error saying so.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: What a product has cost over the last few months, as far as Pricemend has watched it: the lowest and highest seen, and when the price last moved. Use it to tell someone whether today's price is actually good. Returns empty when nobody has watched that product yet.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What Pricemend covers: how many retailers in which countries, how many have live price checking, and how the policy records are sourced. Call this when asked what you can and can't answer about returns.
